summary: The Department of Business and Economic Development, acting through its Natural Resource Development Board, reviewed the Environmental Impact Statements for several highway projects including FA Route 23 (US 30) Section 22-23-12-R in Cook County and stated it had no adverse comment to make. The agency appears twice in the document window: once in a summary table of state clearinghouse agencies and once as a full letter in the appendix, both conveying the same neutral, no-objection position.
complaint_summary: In a letter dated May 2, 1972, the Natural Resource Development Board of the Department of Business and Economic Development states it reviewed the EIS for FA Route 23 (US 30) Section 22-23-12-R, Cook County, among other projects, and has no adverse comment.

statement.text:
The Natural Resource Development Board has reviewed the Environmental Impact Statements for the following highway projects and has no adverse comment to make thereon:
(a) 1-55 Rest Area  Will County
(b) FA Route 23 Section 110-1, Ogle County
(c) FA Route 23 (US 30) Section 22-23-12-R, Cook County
Sincerely,
Ray C. Dickerson
